audit.why: Spikes are sound: Lost Chapter, level 6 R, Luden's; Irelia spikes on Blade of the Ruined King and level 6 Flash-E — already captured in spikes[] and phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; missingInteractions flag anti-heal vs Bladesurge healing, Flawless Duet cancelling Rite of the Arcane channel, and Vanguard's Edge wall cutting Xerath's dash-less retreat.
audit.why: Irelia E cd 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Q 10/9/8/7/6 with kill/Mark resets and self-heal; Xerath R is an interruptible channel and Xerath has no dash.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; channel-cancel and R-wall folded into breakdown.late; anti-heal already present in report[8].

notes: Level chart: full-layer sides were a blanket 'Irelia' on all 7 rows while packet levelChart, content win[] and every phases[N].why said Xerath — flipped side alone per the decided rule (win[N] already correct, no no-op pairs). Ratings and whys left as-is since they already describe Xerath winning. More report[] entries than usual were touched, but every one was a lint-flagged misgender fixed by minimal pronoun swap, not a rewrite. Templated but ungrounded fields left alone: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, enemyWin (template shape but factually fine — Flawless Duet is genuinely the engage tool). Page's HARD/8-10 difficulty vs an all-Xerath chart is tension inherited from the data (50.75% WR); did not adjudicate. Cannot verify from kits whether Irelia W (Defiant Dance) damage reduction applies to Xerath's magic damage (Riot text says physical only — so it does not mitigate Xerath poke), left unstated.
